evidence.availability_quote: We publish the Reddit Politosphere on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5851729 and the accompanying collection of scripts in a GitHub repository at https://github.com/valentinhofmann/politosphere.
evidence.scale_quote: The Reddit Politosphere is based on Reddit and covers more than 600 political discussion groups over a period of 12 years.
evidence.annotation_quote: we therefore conduct a manual cleaning step. Specifically, the first author visits the web presence of each subreddit (or its archived form if the subreddit does not exist anymore) and decides whether it meets our criteria for political subreddits
evidence.ethics_quote: To protect the identity of individual users, the Reddit Politosphere is fully pseudonymized, which sets it apart from most other datasets based on Reddit, including PRD.
evidence.license_quote: it is _reusable_ as it is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.
evidence.ambiguity_notes: total_records (14,971,553) and num_accounts_or_users (7,559,542) are sums of the year-wise figures in Tables 1 and 2 rather than a single stated total; languages_iso includes en only because the paper states most comments are English without counting other languages.
